description: This Java source file defines the class CommonWorkers which provides utility methods for geographic data retrieval and hierarchy checks in the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: CommonWorkers
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for geographic data management and entity hierarchy checking within OFBiz.

methods.name: getCountryList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of country geo entities, prioritizing the default country, and avoiding duplicates.

methods.name: getStateList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of geo entities representing states, provinces, territories, or municipalities.

methods.name: getAssociatedStateList
methods.description: Returns a list of regional geo associations, including states, provinces, and related regions, with recursive support.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks if a given entity type has a specified parent type in its hierarchy, moved to EntityTypeUtil.
